name: Sunny Side Nightmare
source:
Eddie wanted laughs. The circus gave him screams. On debut day, the Ringmaster unveils a horror show where guests join the madness.

Can Eddie survive the nightmare and prove he still belongs?

[From [url=https://korygeki.itch.io/sunny-side-nightmare]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃迪想要笑。马戏团给了他尖叫声。首演当天，领班将推出一场恐怖表演，宾客们也将参与其中。

艾迪能从噩梦中幸存下来并证明他仍然属于自己吗？
